يحقق (form I)

# يَحْقُقْ (yaḥquq) /jaħ.quq/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# يُحْقَقْ (yuḥqaq) /juħ.qaq/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa) and حُقَّ (ḥuqqa)
